description: A value ending in a lone backslash, with a real key on the next line
notes: parse() succeeds - this is structurally a valid file - and decoding Name yields ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof. Named for the failure mode in freedesktop_entry_parser, whose line-continuation logic swallows the rest of the line and the following Exec= key into the Name value, making Exec disappear from the entry entirely.
